checkpoints.title: Get familiar with the interface & organize your project
checkpoints.why: All 4 roadmaps start with setting up the right software foundation before touching footage.

checkpoints.title: Basic cutting & trimming
checkpoints.why: The one thing every roadmap agrees on — cutting is the root skill behind every video, learned before any effect.

checkpoints.title: Transitions & effects
checkpoints.why: Roadmaps A, C, and D all place transitions right after basic cutting — exactly when your video needs to feel smoother.

checkpoints.title: Audio & syncing to the beat
checkpoints.why: The "Short-form content" goal needs cuts that land on the beat — prioritized before color since it affects retention more.

checkpoints.title: Basic color grading
checkpoints.why: Every roadmap agrees: color is a final polish step, not a foundational one.

checkpoints.title: Export & optimize for the platform
checkpoints.why: A mandatory final step across all 4 roadmaps — wrong export settings undo all the work before it.
